variants.title: Alpha spectrometry of Pu-239: energy loss in air and in a foil
variants.method: energy of the main peak against air pressure
variants.unknown: the range in air, the energy resolution and the stopping power of gold
variants.note: Pu-239 emits three lines within 50 keV (5156.6, 5144.3 and 5105.5 keV), unresolved by a detector 18 keV wide, so the peak is their blend, centred near 5150 keV. The same chamber, calibration and procedure apply.
variants.aim: With a Pu-239 source, a silicon surface-barrier detector and a vacuum chamber, calibrate on two sources, let air in step by step and follow the alpha energy down; find the range in air, the energy resolution and the stopping power of gold.
